name: @nextrap/style-utils
description: Nextrap semantic surface and local color-scheme utility classes.

classes.name: surface-primary
classes.description: Readable primary surface: --nt-primary background with --nt-text-on-primary foreground.

classes.name: surface-secondary
classes.description: Readable secondary surface: --nt-secondary background with --nt-text-on-secondary foreground.

classes.name: surface-tertiary
classes.description: Readable tertiary surface: --nt-tertiary background with --nt-text-on-tertiary foreground.

classes.name: surface-accent
classes.description: Readable accent surface: --nt-accent background with --nt-text-on-accent foreground.

classes.name: surface-success
classes.description: Readable success surface: --nt-success background with --nt-text-on-success foreground.

classes.name: surface-info
classes.description: Readable info surface: --nt-info background with --nt-text-on-info foreground.

classes.name: surface-warning
classes.description: Readable warning surface: --nt-warning background with --nt-text-on-warning foreground.

classes.name: surface-danger
classes.description: Readable danger surface: --nt-danger background with --nt-text-on-danger foreground.

classes.name: surface-light
classes.description: Explicit light surface with its matching --nt-text-on-light foreground.

classes.name: surface-dark
classes.description: Explicit dark surface with its matching --nt-text-on-dark foreground.

classes.name: surface-white
classes.description: Explicit white surface with its matching --nt-text-on-white foreground.

classes.name: surface-black
classes.description: Explicit black surface with its matching --nt-text-on-black foreground.

classes.name: scheme-light
classes.description: Force color-scheme: light for this element and descendant subtree so scheme-aware tokens/components evaluate in light mode.

classes.name: scheme-dark
classes.description: Force color-scheme: dark for this element and descendant subtree so scheme-aware tokens/components evaluate in dark mode.
